description_en: Call TagDbfs to assign tags to a DBFS (database file system)
description_zh: 调用TagDbfs为一个数据库文件系统设置标签
kebab_example: aliyun dbfs tag-dbfs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dbfs-id dbfs-nUy1tb00000000BQ4X8Gpw --tags '[{"TagKey":"k1","TagValue":"v1"},{"TagKey":"k2","TagValue":"v2"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagDbfs

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Call DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html) to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh: 所属的地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the database file system
parameters.name: dbfs_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of tags to set.

TagKey: The tag key of the resource. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, and the following special characters: @_-=+;:,<.>/?

TagValue: The tag value of the resource. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, and the following special characters: @_-=+;:,<.>/?
parameters.help_zh:
待设置的标签列表。

TagKey：资源的标签键。取值范围：最大长度为64个字符，可包含英文大小写字母、中文、数字和特殊符号@_-=+;:,<.>/?

TagValue：资源的标签值。取值范围：最大长度为128个字符，可包含英文大小写字母、中文、数字和特殊符号@_-=+;:,<.>/?
parameters.name: tags
